# Playbook: add-link
Use when: X waits for U in the same project

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

## You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user, or lpm-start | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| x | the activity that waits: its id or its exact title | STOP. Say: "Which activity is waiting? (id or exact title)" |
| u | the activity that must finish first: its id or its exact title | STOP. Say: "Which activity must finish first? (id or exact title)" |

## Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was linked."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → switch to playbook connector-only.
2. CALL `list_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   Always make this call, even when the user gave ids: every id below comes from it or from the user.
   SAVE: xid = id of the item whose id == <input:x>, else of the only item whose title == <input:x>, else <input:x> when result.nextCursor is not empty
   SAVE: uid = id of the item whose id == <input:u>, else of the only item whose title == <input:u>, else <input:u> when result.nextCursor is not empty
   IF <saved:xid> is empty → STOP. Say: "Which activity is '<input:x>'? <each item whose title contains it, as "<id>: <title>", or "none in <input:projectId>">. Send its id."
   IF <saved:uid> is empty → STOP. Say: "Which activity is '<input:u>'? <each item whose title contains it, as "<id>: <title>", or "none in <input:projectId>">. Send its id, and its project if it is another one."
   IF <saved:uid> == <saved:xid> → STOP. Say: "An activity cannot block itself. Which activity must finish first?"
3. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<saved:xid> is not an activity of <input:projectId>. Send its id."
   SAVE: xTitle = result.title; workspaceId = result.workspaceId
   IF result.isDeleted == true or result.status is "done" or "canceled" → STOP. Say: "<saved:xid> is <result.status>, not an open activity. Nothing was linked."
4. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:uid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<saved:uid> is not an activity of <input:projectId>. Which project is it in?"
   SAVE: uTitle = result.title; uStatus = result.status
   IF result.isDeleted == true or <saved:uStatus> is "done" or "canceled" → STOP. Say: "<saved:uid> is already <saved:uStatus>, so it blocks nothing. Nothing was linked."
5. CALL `list_issue_links` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   Always make this call before creating: the server does not check duplicates.
   IF an item has type "blocks", sourceIssueId == <saved:uid> and targetIssueId == <saved:xid>, or type "is-blocked-by", sourceIssueId == <saved:xid> and targetIssueId == <saved:uid> → SAVE: linkId = that item's id; outcome = "already linked, nothing created"; go to Answer.
   IF an item has type "blocks", sourceIssueId == <saved:xid> and targetIssueId == <saved:uid>, or type "is-blocked-by", sourceIssueId == <saved:uid> and targetIssueId == <saved:xid> → STOP. Say: "Link <that item's id> says <saved:xid> blocks <saved:uid>. Which must finish first? A link both ways blocks both. Nothing was linked."
6. CALL `create_issue_link` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","sourceIssueId":"<saved:uid>","targetIssueId":"<saved:xid>","type":"blocks"} [A] (no idempotencyKey: this tool has none)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not linked: <error text>. Run this playbook again: it lists the links before creating."
   SAVE: linkId = the id in "Issue link created with ID: <id>"; outcome = "created"
   VERIFY: CALL `list_issue_links` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:linkId>, sourceIssueId == <saved:uid> and targetIssueId == <saved:xid> → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> is not listed. Do not create it again; run this playbook again to check."
   VERIFY: CALL `list_blocked_project_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:xid> → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> exists, but the blocked list does not show <saved:xid>: <error text, or "not listed">."
   SAVE: blockedBy = the "Bloqueado por" value of the item with id == <saved:xid>

## Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<saved:xid> <saved:xTitle>
Done: <link <saved:linkId>: <saved:uid> "<saved:uTitle>" blocks <saved:xid>, <saved:outcome> | nothing linked>
Evidence: <list_issue_links → <saved:linkId>; list_blocked_project_issues → <saved:xid> "Bloqueado por: <saved:blockedBy>" | list_issue_links → <saved:linkId> | none>
Pending: <none — the block ends by itself when <saved:uid> is done or canceled | the STOP text>
Next: <the STOP text that ended the run | finish <saved:uid> (<saved:uStatus>)>
```
uStatus: backlog | todo | in-progress, from step 4. Never set an activity to a status "blocked"; never call the link resolved or say it must be removed when <saved:uid> ends. Never claim a link exists unless step 5 or a VERIFY listed its id.
